title: payment.captured.v1
description: An authorization hold was converted into a debit. Published by Payment Orchestration (BC-6) on pp.payments.payment.v1, keyed by payment_id. Both the per-capture amount and the cumulative total are carried: the ledger posts on the DELTA but reconciles on the TOTAL, and a consumer that had to derive one from the other would be wrong the first time a capture event was redelivered.

capturedAmount.description: This capture only. The ledger posts on this.

capturedTotal.description: Cumulative across all captures. The ledger reconciles on this.

authorizedAmount.description: Invariant I2 evidence: capturedTotal <= authorizedAmount. Carried so a consumer can assert the invariant instead of trusting it.

captureNumber.description: Dense from 1, bounded by the merchant's limits.maxPartialCaptures.

isFinalCapture.description: True when any uncaptured authorization balance was released. False leaves the authorization open for a further partial capture.
